title: Career Roadmap: Genetic Counsellor (after PG)
summary: Career Domain: Agriculture, Food & Life Sciences · Qualification Pathway: B.Sc – Genetics · Target Career: Genetic Counsellor (after PG)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

about.label: Important
about.text: Genetic counselling is a clinical role: a B.Sc alone is not enough to counsel patients.

blocks.text: A Genetic Counsellor helps patients and families understand genetic test results and inherited conditions, and what they mean for health, pregnancy and family planning. The role needs a postgraduate degree in genetic counselling; a B.Sc in Genetics is the starting point.
What a Genetic Counsellor (after PG) does

items.text: Take family histories and assess the risk of inherited conditions
Explain genetic tests and their results in plain language
Support families emotionally through difficult decisions
Work with doctors, labs and fertility or cancer teams
Master Mendelian genetics, cell biology and biochemistry
Read real case stories of genetic conditions
Improve spoken English and one regional language for counselling
Study human genetics, cytogenetics and molecular diagnostics
Learn to draw and read pedigrees
Volunteer with a hospital, NGO or patient-support group
Do a project in a diagnostics or research lab
Learn basic counselling and communication skills (short course)
Apply for M.Sc Genetic Counselling / Medical Genetics

blocks.label: Note
blocks.text: You can work as a genetic counsellor only after a PG in genetic counselling with supervised clinical training.

rows.text: Understanding test reports (karyotype, NGS, prenatal screening)

items.text: Board certification in genetic counselling, once eligible (check the current Indian certifying body)

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
Entrance exams and tests to know:

items.text: University entrance tests for M.Sc (e.g. CUET-PG)
MS in Genetic Counseling (US, UK, Canada, Australia); certification there follows their own boards
